rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user, did not seek explicit confirmation before performing an order-changing action and charging a payment method, and only exchanged the desk lamp while the user requested exchanging both the water bottle and the lamp unless asked for confirmation. It also ignored the stated battery > USB > AC preference by selecting a USB variant without discussion. These violate the policy (authenticate, confirm before writes, act on the user’s own orders) and do not fully complete the user’s request.
